# UX Checklist: Rooms Screens

**Purpose**: UX requirements: empty states, error messages and filter behavior
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Empty States

- [ ] CHK001 Are empty-state requirements defined for every screen that can show a collection (list, administration list)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the difference between "no rooms at all" and "no rooms match" specified, including wording and the offered action? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK003 Are loading and "still loading" states specified, and for how long before a failure is assumed? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the empty state for the equipment choices defined when no room has any equipment? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified who sees the "Add room" action in the empty state, given there is no authentication? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016]

## Error Messages

- [ ] CHK006 Are the message tone and length requirements measurable ("short, direct, no jargon")? [Measurability, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "next to the form" defined for each rejection type (field-level versus form-level)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it specified which rejections map to which field (duplicate name to the name field, invalid capacity to the capacity field)? [Completeness, Spec §US2 Scenarios 3-4]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for errors outside forms: list failing to load, deactivation failing? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the retry behavior after an unreachable system specified for the list and for saving? [Gap, Spec §US2 Scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified that messages are announced to assistive technology and not only shown visually? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the requirement "entered data is kept" defined for all rejection types, including unreachable system? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §US2 Scenario 5]

## Filter Behavior

- [ ] CHK013 Is the timing of automatic filtering quantified, and is the behavior while a request is in flight defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the rules for invalid filter input (zero, negative, non-numeric capacity) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Is it defined whether filters persist when the user leaves the list and returns? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the behavior of the equipment choices defined when the catalog changes after the page loaded? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the phone requirements for the collapsible filter panel specified (default state, how active filters are indicated when collapsed)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK018 Are filter requirements consistent across phone, tablet and desktop layouts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009..FR-011]

## Cross-cutting

- [ ] CHK019 Is the deactivation warning requirement consistent with what the system can actually return before the change is made? [Conflict, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the keyboard behaviors for dialogs (focus trap, return of focus, escape) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the visual treatment of the inactive state measurable (label text, contrast of the greyed content)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the behavior defined for a very long name or many equipment items on each layout? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
